title: Ivanti Avalanche SecureFilter Content-Type Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to partially bypass authentication on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SecureFilter class. The issue results from improper handling of URIs and their accompanying Content-Type HTTP request headers. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to partially bypass authentication on the application.
